What a kind thing to d
Often, being polite means simply adding a few extra words or arranging
your words in a certain way. Start with a basic statement or question, and
then add the words or order necessary to make it polite.
There are a few idioms, like those in the chart above, that you can use to be more polite. It’s a good idea to
memorize these so you can use them easily when you need them.
